summary: Final forensic adjudication report for Mission 014 (Task Audit). The audit has successfully reproduced the results of Mission 013 but identified significant physical accuracy gaps. While the FSI system is 'Physically Active' and demonstrates numerical stability (grid independence), it suffers from 50% displacement error and 20% moment error due to shear locking in the 2D QUAD elements. Evidence integrity and mesh safety guards are confirmed. The final verdict is PARTIAL_CLOSURE with a rejection of Industrial Beta status until discretization fidelity is improved.
